CustomField.description: Seller-visible green/yellow/red margin indicator. Numeric Margin / UnitCost stay FLS-hidden for sellers; deal desk sees both.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Margin), IMAGE("/img/samples/light_yellow.gif", "No margin"), IF( OR( AND(Margin >= 1, Margin >= 35), AND(Margin > 0, Margin < 1, Margin >= 0.35) ), IMAGE("/img/samples/light_green.gif", "Healthy margin"), IF( OR( AND(Margin >= 1, Margin >= 20), AND(Margin > 0, Margin < 1, Margin >= 0.20) ), IMAGE("/img/samples/light_yellow.gif", "Watch margin"), IMAGE("/img/samples/light_red.gif", "Low margin") ) ) )
CustomField.label: Margin Health
